requirements.title: Public Nation homepage loads as a usable marketing page
requirements.description: https://nation.dev/ must return a successful document, show a title and readable content, and avoid unexpected first-party console/network/HTTP failures. This is smoke coverage, not a visual design review.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Homepage document response is HTTP < 400
Homepage has a non-empty document title
Homepage body contains visible readable text
Homepage has no unexpected JavaScript console errors
Homepage has no unexpected failed network requests
Homepage has no first-party HTTP 4xx/5xx responses during load
Visible homepage links use valid URL schemes
Homepage is served over HTTPS

requirements.title: Public Nation homepage exposes primary user actions
requirements.description: Anonymous visitors can find talent/organization join paths, theme control, legal links and intact marketing copy. Sidebar collapse is observed, not treated as a release blocker.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Primary homepage heading is visible
Join as a talent link is visible and navigates away from the homepage
Join as an organization link is visible and navigates away from the homepage
Theme toggle changes visible or stored theme state
Sidebar trigger is visible and clickable
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use links have destinations
Homepage does not contain the known duplicated skills sentence

requirements.title: Sign-in page presents a usable credential form
requirements.description: https://nation.dev/signin loads and exposes email, password and submit controls. Coverage does not include a successful authenticated session.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Sign-in page loads with HTTP < 400 and a usable email/password form
Email, password and submit controls are visible and usable
Sign-in fields accept typed values without submitting a real login
Forgot-password link from sign-in reaches /forgot-password

requirements.title: Password reset page collects an email address
requirements.description: https://nation.dev/forgot-password exposes an email field and a submit control. Mail delivery and token reset are not verified.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Forgot-password page has an editable email field
Forgot-password page has a visible submit control

requirements.title: Sign-up page exposes registration controls
requirements.description: https://nation.dev/signup loads and shows registration inputs plus a submit control. Account creation is not executed.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Sign-up page loads with a registration heading
Sign-up page has at least one visible input and a submit control

requirements.title: Authentication pages do not leak raw runtime errors
requirements.description: Anonymous /signin, /signup and /forgot-password must not render TypeError, stack traces or Internal Server Error text in the body.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Sign-in, sign-up and forgot-password pages do not show raw runtime error text

requirements.title: A test account can establish an authenticated Nation session
requirements.description: Not covered by the current suite unless NATION_TEST_EMAIL and NATION_TEST_PASSWORD are set. Successful login, session cookie and redirect away from /signin remain a gap.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Valid test credentials sign in and leave the /signin URL
An authenticated storageState can be reused across tests

requirements.title: Authenticated Nation routes remain available after login
requirements.description: Deep Discovery currently sees /home, /jobs and /profile redirect anonymous users to /signin. There is no logged-in test that proves those routes work for a member.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Authenticated user can open /home without being sent back to /signin
Authenticated user can open /jobs
Authenticated user can open /profile

requirements.title: Legal documents are linked from the public site
requirements.description: Privacy and terms URLs exist on the homepage. Full legal-page content review is out of scope.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Homepage privacy and terms links have non-empty href values
Privacy Policy page loads without an HTTP error
Terms of Use page loads without an HTTP error

requirements.title: Discovered Nation routes return a successful main document
requirements.description: Generated page-load checks cover routes from dashboard/data/discovered-pages-nation.json. This is HTTP smoke coverage, not functional coverage of each route.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Each discovered Nation page main response is HTTP < 400 and renders a body

requirements.title: Public Nation marketing and community pages load
requirements.description: Anonymous visitors can open /manifesto, /made-with-sweden and /partner-join without a login. These are public routes from Deep Discovery, not authenticated member pages.

acceptanceCriteria.title: /manifesto loads with visible content
/made-with-sweden loads with visible content
/partner-join loads with visible content

requirements.title: Anonymous visitors are sent to sign-in for member routes
requirements.description: /home, /jobs, /profile and /benchmarks are not public. Without NATION_TEST_* credentials the suite asserts the anonymous redirect to /signin rather than member content. Authenticated access remains REQ-NATION-PROTECTED-001.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Anonymous /home redirects to /signin
Anonymous /jobs redirects to /signin (jobs listing is not public)
Anonymous /profile redirects to /signin
Anonymous /benchmarks redirects to /signin

requirements.title: AI Skills catalog page loads
requirements.description: https://aiskills.nation.dev/skills is the public catalog entry. Coverage is load/title/content plus unexpected JS/network/HTTP checks.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Catalog URL stays on aiskills.nation.dev/skills
Catalog page has a non-empty title
Catalog page has visible body text
Catalog page has no unexpected JavaScript errors
Catalog page has no unexpected failed requests
Catalog page has no HTTP 4xx/5xx responses during load
Catalog exposes navigation toward learning or named skill pages
Catalog is served over HTTPS

requirements.title: AI Skills learning routes are usable
requirements.description: Anonymous /assessment, /path and /practice load with visible content. Completing an assessment, finishing a path, or submitting practice still requires a product scenario and may need AI_SKILLS_TEST_* credentials.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Assessment page loads and shows a task, prompt or start control
Learning path page shows a usable path structure
Practice page exposes a practice task

requirements.title: Named skill and task pages load
requirements.description: Scanner inventory includes /skills/gamma, /skills/claude, /skills/notebooklm and nested task URLs. Generated smoke tests cover HTTP load only. /skills/notebooklm has previously failed a network check in scan output.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Discovered AI Skills pages return HTTP < 400 for the main document

requirements.title: AI Skills sign-in is usable
requirements.description: https://aiskills.nation.dev/signin exposes a login form for anonymous visitors. Successful Skills login stays skipped unless AI_SKILLS_TEST_EMAIL and AI_SKILLS_TEST_PASSWORD are set.

acceptanceCriteria.title: AI Skills sign-in page exposes a usable login form
Optional AI_SKILLS_TEST_* credentials can establish a session

requirements.title: Deep Discovery can crawl each configured site
requirements.description: tests/discovery/sentinel-discovery.spec.ts crawls nation.dev and aiskills.nation.dev and writes reports/discovery/<site>.json.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Deep Discovery completes for the project-mapped Sentinel site
